search_text: What is transfer of property under Transfer of Property Act

hi.title: संपत्ति का अंतरण
hi.summary: जीवित व्यक्ति द्वारा किसी अन्य जीवित व्यक्ति को संपत्ति हस्तांतरित करना।

question: What is a transfer of property?
answer: Transfer of property means an act by which a living person conveys property, in present or future, to one or more other living persons, or to himself and one or more other living persons.

hi.title: कौन-सी संपत्ति हस्तांतरित की जा सकती है
hi.summary: कानून द्वारा प्रतिबंधित संपत्ति को छोड़कर सभी प्रकार की संपत्ति हस्तांतरित की जा सकती है।

question: Can every type of property be transferred?
answer: Yes. Property of any kind may be transferred unless its transfer is prohibited by this Act or any other law.

hi.title: हस्तांतरित न की जा सकने वाली संपत्ति
hi.summary: कुछ अधिकार जैसे मुकदमा करने का अधिकार, भविष्य का भरण-पोषण आदि हस्तांतरित नहीं किए जा सकते।

question: Which rights cannot be transferred?
answer: Certain rights such as a mere right to sue, future maintenance, public office and similar restricted interests cannot be transferred.

hi.title: कौन संपत्ति हस्तांतरित कर सकता है
hi.summary: जो व्यक्ति अनुबंध करने में सक्षम है और संपत्ति पर अधिकार रखता है।

question: Who is competent to transfer property?
answer: Any person competent to contract and entitled to transferable property, or legally authorised to dispose of it, may transfer such property.

hi.title: हस्तांतरण का प्रभाव
hi.summary: हस्तांतरण के साथ संपत्ति से जुड़े सभी अधिकार भी स्थानांतरित हो जाते हैं।

question: What rights pass to the transferee after transfer?
answer: Unless otherwise intended, the transfer passes all the interest that the transferor is capable of passing together with its legal incidents.

hi.title: मौखिक हस्तांतरण
hi.summary: जहाँ कानून लिखित दस्तावेज़ आवश्यक नहीं बनाता, वहाँ मौखिक हस्तांतरण संभव है।

question: Can property be transferred orally?
answer: Yes. A transfer of property may be made without writing wherever a written instrument is not expressly required by law.

hi.title: हस्तांतरण पर पूर्ण प्रतिबंध
hi.summary: संपत्ति के हस्तांतरण पर पूर्ण रोक लगाने वाली शर्त सामान्यतः अमान्य होती है।

question: Can a property transfer permanently restrict future transfer?
answer: No. A condition absolutely restraining the transferee from transferring or disposing of the property is generally void, except in certain lease-related situations.

hi.title: अमान्य प्रतिबंध
hi.summary: पूर्ण स्वामित्व देने के बाद उसके उपयोग पर अनुचित प्रतिबंध सामान्यतः प्रभावी नहीं होता।

question: Can the transferor control how absolute ownership is enjoyed?
answer: Where absolute ownership is transferred, directions restricting the enjoyment of that interest are generally ineffective.

hi.title: दिवालियापन की शर्त
hi.summary: दिवालिया होने पर अधिकार समाप्त करने वाली शर्त सामान्यतः अमान्य होती है।

question: Can a transfer end automatically if the transferee becomes insolvent?
answer: A condition causing an interest to cease merely because the transferee becomes insolvent or attempts to transfer it is generally void, subject to lease-related exceptions.

question: Can property be transferred for the benefit of an unborn person?
answer: Yes, but only if the transfer extends to the whole of the remaining interest of the transferor after the prior interest.

hi.title: स्थायित्व के विरुद्ध नियम

question: What is the rule against perpetuity?
answer: Property cannot be transferred in a manner that postpones the vesting of ownership beyond the period permitted by law.

hi.title: जनहित के लिए स्थायी हस्तांतरण
hi.summary: धर्म, शिक्षा, स्वास्थ्य या जनहित के उद्देश्यों के लिए विशेष प्रावधान लागू होते हैं।

question: Does the rule against perpetuity apply to public charitable purposes?
answer: No. Certain transfers made for public purposes such as religion, education, health, safety and other beneficial objectives are exempt from these restrictions.

search_text: What is vested interest under Transfer of Property Act

hi.title: निहित हित (Vested Interest)
hi.summary: यदि कोई अधिकार तुरंत या निश्चित घटना पर मिलने वाला है, तो वह निहित हित माना जाता है।

question: What is a vested interest?
answer: An interest created without specifying a future uncertain event, or to take effect immediately or upon an event that must happen, is a vested interest unless the transfer shows a contrary intention.

search_text: Does vested interest end on death

question: Does a vested interest end if the transferee dies before possession?
answer: No. A vested interest is not defeated merely because the transferee dies before obtaining possession.

search_text: When unborn child gets vested interest

hi.title: अजन्मे बच्चे का अधिकार

question: When does an unborn child acquire a vested interest?
answer: An unborn person acquires a vested interest immediately upon birth unless a contrary intention appears from the transfer.

hi.title: आकस्मिक हित

question: What is a contingent interest?
answer: A contingent interest arises when the transfer depends upon the happening or non-happening of a specified uncertain event.

hi.title: निर्धारित आयु

question: Can property be transferred only to those who attain a specified age?
answer: Yes. Only those members of the class who attain the specified age acquire the interest created under the transfer.

hi.title: अवैध शर्त
hi.summary: यदि शर्त कानून, नैतिकता या सार्वजनिक नीति के विरुद्ध है तो वह अमान्य होगी।

question: When does a conditional transfer fail?
answer: A conditional transfer fails if the condition is impossible, unlawful, fraudulent, immoral or opposed to public policy.

question: What is the doctrine of election?
answer: Where a person transfers property without authority but confers a benefit on the true owner in the same transaction, the owner must elect either to confirm the transfer or reject it and relinquish the benefit.
